utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo — I can bring a few tools by and help sort out whatever’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—thanks, Gus. It’s now Sunday at the community center, so just bring the tools there and we’ll sort everything out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Leo — I’ll bring the tools over to the community center now and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I’m still able to help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — the drive’s moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’m just sorting the exact parts list and making sure we’ve got the tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Sunday at the community center. Send me the parts list and tool needs when you have them, and I’ll double-check what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I’ll pass along anything I hear too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — if I hear the drop-off spot, I’ll let you know right away. Thanks for keeping an ear out too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep listening and send anything I hear your way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina. I’ll bring the repair-drive details by later today once I’ve sorted them out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — just bring them by when you’re ready. I’ll keep an eye out for the time and setup details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I will — thanks, Mina. I’ll bring by the time and setup details later today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — 9 a.m. still works for me. I’ll let you know if I catch any changes on my end.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Noah — I’ll keep things at 9 a.m. and send along any updates if they come up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — thanks, Faye. I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if anything changes on my side.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still pulling together the parts list and timing, and Saturday still works. I’ve made sure everyone’s invited to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — I can start lining up a few volunteers and asking around for tool donations. Send me the parts list when you can, and I’ll help fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I’ll send the parts list and timing as soon as I finish it. Thanks for helping fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still good to help with the repair drive. If you have a clear list, I can stick to it and keep things orderly.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great — I’ll bring back the latest update and a clear list of what we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me — I’ll be ready for the update and the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks — I’ll watch for your details later today and keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m a bit late — I can still help with the repair drive. What’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane — we still need the final fix list and any last-minute updates, but you can jump in wherever it’s easiest. I’ll pass along anything new as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—just tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I can check what supplies we already have and make a quick list of what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. That’d help a lot—let me know what’s still needed, and I can take care of it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep mentioning it to the others and make sure the repair drive keeps moving forward.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll keep looping folks in and repeat the repair-drive details as I go. If you want, I can help get you matched with a specific task.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — it’s Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday at the front porch. I’ll send the homes and supplies when I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m available and ready to help. Send the homes and supplies when you can, and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll get the homes and supplies over soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and line up the regular helpers plus a few handy folks for Saturday. We should have a solid crew for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — just confirming, Quinn, are you definitely set on having a solid crew for Saturday’s repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes — I’m definitely on it, and I’ll have a solid crew lined up for Saturday’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the tools and be there to help with the repair drive. Just keep me posted if anything else is needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — what time should I show up, and is there anything specific you want me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Show up around 9 if that works, and if you can bring gloves and a water bottle, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Eli — I’ll plan around 9 and keep an eye out for your fix list and meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: You’re welcome, Mara. I’ll bring it by around 9.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll be here around 9 and ready to help once you bring the list by.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to the regular helpers and a few handy folks right away. Saturday’s repair drive should have a solid crew.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — just a quick note that it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll want to confirm the timing with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll let everyone know it’s Sunday at the community center and confirm the timing too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll send the homes and supplies I have; just make sure everything’s powered down before we start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll help keep folks posted, line up a few volunteers, and ask around for tool donations. What else do you still need for Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly just the final homes list and any extra tools or extension cords folks can lend. Thanks — that should cover Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll bring the repair-drive details by later today once I’ve sorted them out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure—just let me know what still needs doing, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’m still sorting the details, but I’ll bring them by later today.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I’m ready to help, I just need the details again.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing together the details, but I heard it’s soon near the community center. If you know the drop-off spot, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I don’t have the exact drop-off spot yet, but I’ll ask around and get back to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Hana — just to confirm, are you definitely able to help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I can help with the repair drive. I’m just checking what still needs doing, and then I can confirm when I’ll come by.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Hana — just confirming, are you definitely able to come by for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m putting together the supplies list now, and I’ll let you know what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll check the community center next and let you know what tools they still need.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Opal — I’ll compare notes once you’re back and fill in any gaps on the supplies list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — it’s on Sunday now at the community center. I can help sort or carry items; let me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Leo — I can still help too. Let me know whether you want me sorting, carrying, or something else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sorting would help most, and carrying too if you’ve got time. I’ll send you the latest list before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s now on Sunday at the community center. I’ll send you the details and let you know how you can help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still on it. I’ll finish my errands and check back for the details on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Ira — thanks for staying on it. I’ll send the details soon, and just check back when you can.
